title: Usage heuristics and API examples for controls and data views
creator: Ava Patel
description: Create a comprehensive set of authoring guidelines and runnable API examples for core UI primitives (tokens, buttons) and data view components (tables, charts). Focus on: clear usage heuristics, concise do/don't guidance, concrete migration notes from legacy tokens, and canonical code samples (React/TS + MDX) that engineering and external integrators can copy. Aim to reduce ambiguity that causes repeated RFCs and implementation drift.
acceptance_criteria: A single MDX page per component group (Tokens / Buttons / Tables / Charts) exists in the docs site with: summary, heuristics, do/don't, accessibility notes, and 3 runnable examples each.
Code samples compile in the design-system monorepo and Storybook; CI runs the Storybook snapshot tests without regressions.
Migration appendix that lists deprecated token names mapped to current semantic tokens, plus a codemod link or script that automates the 80% common replacements.
API reference tables that show props, types, default values and short example snippets for each exported component (flat list that can be ingested by our docs generator).
Engineering and PM signoff entries recorded in comments and a review PR merged (or blockers documented).
tasks: Audit existing docs and components for gaps (tokens, buttons, tables, charts).
Draft heuristics and do/don't guidance (one-liners + 2 concrete examples each).
Author runnable MDX examples and wire them into Storybook stories (React/TS).
Write migration appendix with mapping table and codemod example (jscodeshift).
Add accessibility checklist for each component: keyboard, focus, labels, contrast, reduced motion.
Create small API reference CSV/flat file for docs generator ingestion.
Open docs PR and request reviews from Eng and PM; iterate on feedback.
comments: 2026-03-01 - Ava Patel: Initial ticket created after offsite review—multiple teams asked for clearer guidance on token semantics and table APIs. Goal: reduce integration questions by 50% for next quarter.

2026-03-03 - Luca Moreno: Ran quick audit; found ~17 pages with inconsistent prop names for Table selection and 9 chart examples using hardcoded palette colors. Will consolidate patterns into canonical stories.

2026-03-05 - Mei Chen (Eng): Recommend exposing a single 'variant' prop for buttons (primary, secondary, ghost) instead of multiple booleans. Engineering prefers an additive prop pattern for minimal breaking changes. Need decision.
2026-03-06 - Product: PM review—prioritize migration appendix and codemod so partner integrations can upgrade with minimal manual work. Also request a short FAQ for common regressions.

2026-03-08 - Design review: Agreed to use 'semantic token' nomenclature in all examples (e.g., color.bg.surface, color.fg.primary). Add a note about when direct palette tokens are acceptable (visual explorations only).
2026-03-09 - Eng feedback on API docs format: provide a flat CSV with columns (component, prop, type, default, description, examples) so backend can generate pages. Will include that file in PR.
2026-03-10 - Luca Moreno: Draft PR opened (link below). Still blocked on final decision for button prop deprecation strategy—proposal added to PR for review.
notes: Decision: Keep backward compatibility by adding alias tokens for one release cycle and ship a lint rule that flags deprecated token usage.
Implementation detail: MDX examples should import the live ThemeProvider from the monorepo to reflect actual runtime token values.
Charts: include accessible palette recipe (>=4.5:1 contrast for foreground on backgrounds used for important data).
Tables: document virtualization patterns and provide two examples: paginated server-side fetch and infinite scroll with windowing. Include keyboard navigation behavior and ARIA roles.
